A0166.title: On-Chain Compliance and Regulatory Collaboration
A0166.definition: Collaborating with regulatory authorities to establish on-chain monitoring mechanisms and compliance reporting
A0166.description: Compliance framework: Travel Rule implementation; suspicious transaction reporting; blacklist sharing; regulatory nodes; on-chain regulatory technology; cross-border collaboration; forensic interfaces.
A0166.limitation: Regulatory standards vary across jurisdictions and cross-border collaboration faces high barriers; decentralized protocols lack a central accountable entity, inherently conflicting with regulatory requirements; privacy coins and mixers undermine on-chain traceability; on-chain compliance cannot be enforced directly and must rely on indirect measures such as off-chain fiat channels for intervention.
